page: Microsoft Azure L12aos_v5 is a virtual machine within the Laosv5 server family, utilizing AMD x86_64 processors. Operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this instance provides 12 dedicated vCPUs and 96.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

A primary feature of the L12aos_v5 is its local storage configuration, which delivers 8640 GB of NVMe SSD capacity. The instance is also Premium Storage capable, allowing for integration with high-performance external storage options. This server does not include integrated GPUs and is provisioned with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the high ratio of local NVMe SSD storage to virtual compute resources, this server type offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring large-capacity, low-latency local scratch space. The combination of dedicated AMD cores, 96.0 GB of memory, and massive local storage makes it highly suitable for relational databases, NoSQL data stores, and transactional processing systems.
